nodes.description: Private address state variable storing the beneficiary of the locked tokens.
Private bool state variable indicating whether the lock has been initiated.
Private uint256 state variable for the timestamp when token release becomes possible.
Constructor of TokenTimelock that sets the beneficiary address.
Public virtual function initiating the unlock timestamp; guarded by beneficiary-only check and future timestamp check.
Public view returning the beneficiary address.
Public view returning the configured release time.
Public view returning whether the lock was initiated.
Public view returning whether block.timestamp is past the release time.
Public view returning the token balance held by the timelock contract.
Public virtual function increasing the unlock timestamp; beneficiary-only and must be greater than current release time.
Public virtual function transferring all held tokens to the beneficiary once the release time has passed.
Caller address used for beneficiary authorization checks in initiateLock and increaseLock.
Block timestamp used for release-time comparisons and lock initiation validation.
External token transfer call (safeTransfer -> low-level call) made inside release; potential reentrancy/callback vector.
Beneficiary address parameter of the TokenTimelock constructor.
Requested release time parameter of initiateLock.
New release time parameter of increaseLock.
IERC20 token parameter of release.
IERC20 token parameter of holdings.
Local variable holding the contract token balance computed in release.
Constructor of the derived TwittelonInuTimelock contract forwarding the beneficiary to the base constructor.
Beneficiary address parameter of the TwittelonInuTimelock constructor.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter beneficiary is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor writes the _beneficiary state variable.
msg.sender is compared against _beneficiary as an authorization guard in initiateLock.
releaseTime parameter flows into the release time validation and assignment in initiateLock.
block.timestamp is used to validate that releaseTime is in the future, creating timestamp dependency.
initiateLock assigns the releaseTime value to the _releaseTime state variable.
initiateLock sets _lockInitiated to true.
initiateLock reads _beneficiary in the caller authorization require.
release reads _beneficiary as the recipient of the token transfer.
release checks the _lockInitiated flag before transferring.
release relies on block.timestamp being greater than or equal to _releaseTime, a timestamp dependency.
release reads the _releaseTime state variable in its time require.
The token parameter is used to query balance and perform the transfer in release.
release performs an external token transfer, which can invoke a callback into the token contract before state finalization.
The external transfer sends tokens to the _beneficiary address.
The token parameter is used to query the balance held by the contract in holdings.
unlocked compares block.timestamp against the release time, a timestamp dependency.
unlocked reads the _releaseTime state variable for its comparison.
beneficiary view returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime view returns the _releaseTime state variable.
initiated view returns the _lockInitiated state variable.
msg.sender is compared against _beneficiary as an authorization guard in increaseLock.
newReleaseTime parameter is validated and written to the _releaseTime state variable in increaseLock.
increaseLock writes the _releaseTime state variable with the new release time.
increaseLock requires the _lockInitiated flag to be true.
increaseLock reads _beneficiary in its caller authorization require.
release stores the queried token balance into the amount local variable.
The amount local variable is passed as the value of the external token transfer.
The token balance query in release produces the amount local variable.
TwittelonInuTimelock constructor parameter beneficiary flows into the base constructor invocation.
The derived constructor calls the TokenTimelock base constructor.
